title: Coinbase premium (US spot demand) as a signal for BTC/ETH CFDs and as a C* filter

data: Coinbase Exchange BTC-USD / ETH-USD hourly closes (public API) vs Binance USD-M BTCUSDT / ETHUSDT hourly closes, 2020-01 .. 2026-09
signal: premium_t = Coinbase close / Binance close - 1 per coin; P24 = its 24-hour mean; z = (P24 - 30-day mean of P24) / 30-day std of P24, all known at hour t
